_readme: Federal student loan and student aid parameters, each read on the official document cited in `sources` (copies in research/). Never type one of these figures in a page: read it here through src/lib/kit.ts. Retrieved 2026-10-11.

law._source: obbba (Public Law 119-21, signed July 4, 2025; the Department of Education now calls it the Working Families Tax Cuts Act: riseFinal).

rates._source: ratesNotice (Federal Register 2026-18493, September 10, 2026): 10-year Treasury high yield at the May 12, 2026 auction 4.468%, rounded to 4.47%, plus the statutory add-on, capped at the statutory maximum. Fixed for the life of the loan.

autopay._source: edAutopay (June 18, 2026) and edAutopayExtend (September 29, 2026): 1 percentage point total reduction for borrowers in auto pay, through June 30, 2028, if enrolled by December 31, 2026; the usual reduction outside the offer is 0.25 point. Direct Loans originated after July 1, 2012.

ibr._source: HEA sec. 493C as amended by obbba sec. 82001(f); riseFinal, 34 CFR 685.209(b)(1), (b)(13)(ii), (f)(2)-(3), (g)(1)(iii), (k)(1)-(2).

save._source: 34 CFR 685.209(f)(1) (REPAYE/SAVE formula, still printed in riseFinal through June 30, 2028); the plan is closed under the settlement approved in March 2026 (edSaveNextSteps).

standard._source: 34 CFR 685.208(b)(1) (10-year standard, $50 minimum) and (b)(8), (c)(1) (Tiered Standard); HEA sec. 455(d)(7)(A)(i).

limits._source: 34 CFR 685.203 (eCFR, current) and HEA sec. 455(a)(4)-(6) added by obbba sec. 81001; riseFinal.

pslf._source: 34 CFR 685.219 (eCFR, current, with the qualifying-employer amendments effective July 1, 2026: pslfRule) and HEA sec. 455(m) as amended by obbba sec. 82004.

fpl._source: hhs2026 (2026 guidelines, used for IBR and RAP-era payment estimates) and frPoverty2024 (2024 guidelines, used by the 2026-27 FAFSA for Pell thresholds, saiGuide). [first person, each additional person], annual dollars.

employer127._source: obbba sec. 70412 (26 U.S.C. 127(c)(1)(B) made permanent for payments after December 31, 2025; inflation adjustment for taxable years beginning after 2026) and irsRp2532 sec. 3.09.

tax._source: obbba sec. 70119 rewrote 26 U.S.C. 108(f)(5): from 2026 it excludes only discharges for death or total and permanent disability.

s529._source: obbba sec. 70413 and 70414 (26 U.S.C. 529): K-12 tuition limit raised from $10,000 to $20,000 for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2025; credential programs added; irsRp2532 sec. 4.42 gift exclusion.

pell._source: approps (Public Law 119-75, approved February 3, 2026: maximum Pell Grant $6,335 for award year 2026-2027) plus the $1,060 of 20 U.S.C. 1070a(b)(5)(A)(i) (hea401); minimum = 10% of the total maximum (hea401 (a)(3)(F)); SAI thresholds: saiGuide; high-SAI rule and grant-aid exclusion: obbba sec. 83001(b), 83004.

sai._source: saiGuide (2026-27 Student Aid Index and Pell Grant Eligibility Guide, June 2025) and needAnalysis (Federal Register 2025-10243, June 5, 2025).

obbba.label: Public Law 119-21 (July 4, 2025), Title VIII, secs. 80001 to 85002 (loan limits, repayment, PSLF, Pell) and secs. 70119, 70412 to 70414 (tax)

riseFinal.label: Department of Education, RISE final regulations, 91 FR 23768 (May 1, 2026), effective July 1, 2026: 34 CFR 685.203, 685.208, 685.209, 685.219

ratesNotice.label: Department of Education, Annual Notice of Interest Rates for Fixed-Rate Direct Loans, Federal Register 2026-18493 (September 10, 2026)

ecfr209.label: 34 CFR 685.209, income-driven repayment plans (IBR, RAP, ICR, PAYE, REPAYE), eCFR

ecfr208.label: 34 CFR 685.208, fixed payment plans: 10-year standard and Tiered Standard, eCFR

ecfr203.label: 34 CFR 685.203, Direct Loan annual and aggregate limits, eCFR

ecfr219.label: 34 CFR 685.219, Public Service Loan Forgiveness, eCFR

pslfRule.label: Department of Education, PSLF qualifying employer final rule, 90 FR 48966 (October 31, 2025), effective July 1, 2026

edFactSheet.label: Department of Education, Fact Sheet: Simplifying Student Loan Repayment (June 9, 2026)

edJuly1.label: Department of Education, Fact Sheet of July 1, 2026: new plans, loan limits and Workforce Pell in effect

edSaveNextSteps.label: Department of Education, Next Steps for Borrowers Enrolled in the SAVE Plan (March 27, 2026)

edSaveAgreement.label: Department of Education, Agreement with Missouri to end the SAVE Plan (December 9, 2025)

edAutopay.label: Department of Education, Student Loan Interest Rate Reduction for auto pay (June 18, 2026)

edAutopayExtend.label: Department of Education, Enrollment Period Extended for the Interest Rate Reduction (September 29, 2026)

edCollections.label: Department of Education, Involuntary Collections Delayed (January 16, 2026)

edRiseFinal.label: Department of Education, Final Rule on loan limits and repayment (April 30, 2026)

edPslf.label: Department of Education, Final Rule on Public Service Loan Forgiveness (October 30, 2025)

edFafsa2728.label: Department of Education, 2027-28 FAFSA form launched (September 23, 2026)

hhs2026.label: HHS ASPE, 2026 Poverty Guidelines for the 48 states and DC, Alaska and Hawaii

frPoverty2024.label: Federal Register, Annual Update of the HHS Poverty Guidelines, 2024 (January 17, 2024), used for 2026-27 Pell thresholds

saiGuide.label: Federal Student Aid, 2026-27 Student Aid Index (SAI) and Pell Grant Eligibility Guide

needAnalysis.label: Federal Register 2025-10243, Federal Need Analysis Methodology for the 2026-27 Award Year (June 5, 2025)

approps.label: Public Law 119-75 (February 3, 2026), consolidated appropriations: maximum Pell Grant of $6,335 for award year 2026-2027

hea401.label: 20 U.S.C. 1070a (HEA sec. 401), Federal Pell Grants: total maximum and minimum award

irsRp2532.label: IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32, inflation adjustments for tax year 2026 (sec. 4.29 student loan interest)

irc127.label: 26 U.S.C. 127, educational assistance programs (employer student loan payments)
